provider_enforced_usage_blocks.notes: Minimum permitted 1-cent provider overage threshold. Metering is asynchronous and does not cover D1/Queues/KV/R2.

warnings: Provider 1-cent usage blocks cannot promise zero excess charges.
D1, Queues, KV, R2, storage, taxes and independent provider bills are not controlled by Workers/DO spend blocks.
Soft quotas can be bypassed by independent Workers, cron, GitHub Actions, third-party clients and delayed provider counters unless individually integrated.
A strict never-exceed-$5 invoice cannot be guaranteed with a metered Workers Paid account.

Owner daily D1 targets 120k rows read and 180k written are internal account-wide soft targets and cannot be guaranteed by non-atomic GraphQL counters; Cloudflare Workers Paid has monthly D1 included allowance instead of Free daily physical limits.
